params.caption: 🖥️ Report: Nvidia's board may move to oust Jensen Huang Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to remove Jensen Huang, the company's first and only CEO in 33 years, after a report of a second alleged affair, this time with an executive who reported to him. The stock has dropped about 20% since the scandals began, and Nvidia has no public succession plan. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 02:45 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 😮 React if you didn't see this coming · 💬 What would it mean for GeForce? #Nvidia #GPU #GamingNews
